sth_landlord.text: Welcome to the Crapaud Arms. Toads: Jerseymen. We took the name and put it on the sign, which is the right way to deal with an insult.
We do a bean crock on Saturdays. It's a stew of beans, pork and a pig's trotter that cooks slowly for hours. It was taken to the baker's oven on a Saturday night and fetched after church on Sunday.

sth_quiz.text: Tonight's warm-up: what does a Jerseyman get called, and why? A crapaud, a toad. Nobody knows why. That's an easy point.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: Fair enough. The offer stands, and so does the bar.
